description: Scheduled and metric-reactive Azure compute autoscaling via ARM API. Supports VM, VMSS, and App Service Plan resize with managed identity auth. Designed to replace Bellhop with full idempotency, replay, and audit trail.
notes: Managed identity only — connection strings and API keys are not supported.
Use a dedicated UAMI for this pack with 'Virtual Machine Scale Set Contributor' + 'Reader' on the target RG. See runbook.md for setup steps.
AZURE_COMPUTE_MI_CLIENT_ID is the client ID (GUID) of the pack's user-assigned MSI, stored in App Configuration. Do NOT use a shared worker MSI in production.
Cron schedules are set in execution-ledger-scheduler; Drasi continuous queries drive reactive overrides.
